global.name: Global MOLA topography
global.resolutionNote: 0.25° grid, 14.818 km nominal at the equator
global.source: NASA PDS • Mars Global Surveyor MOLA MEGDR 4 pixels/degree
global.processing: Native NASA grid cells with centers derived from the 0.25° bin extents. Columns rotated to signed east longitude. PDS interpolates empty bins.

regions.name: Jezero western fan
regions.resolutionNote: Native 20 m spacing in source projection; local east–west ground spacing varies with latitude.
regions.source: USGS Astrogeology / NASA Mars 2020 • CTX stereo DEM mosaic
regions.processing: Native center pixels from Jezero CTX Science Investigation DEM; inverse equirectangular projection to planetocentric coordinates; heights rounded to 0.01 m for serialization only.

waypoints.name: Fan-front observation
waypoints.description: Hypothetical stop to look for exposed layering near the western fan front.

demo.description: Plan a hypothetical traverse from the Perseverance landing vicinity toward the Jezero western fan. The destination and observation stop are proposed planning points.

regions.name: Gale lower Mount Sharp
regions.resolutionNote: Approximately 10.1 m grid posts, every tenth native 1.01 m sample; detail below the grid spacing is unresolved.
regions.source: NASA / JPL-Caltech / University of Arizona • HiRISE stereo DTM
regions.processing: DTEEC_040770_1755_039280_1755_A01. Pixel centers from PDS3 line/sample offsets, sampled at a ten-pixel interval along each axis. No-data retained; heights rounded to 0.01 m for serialization only.

waypoints.name: Lower-slope observation
waypoints.description: Hypothetical stop to inspect bedding and compare material along the lower slopes.

demo.description: Compare hypothetical traverses on the lower slopes of Mount Sharp near Pahrump Hills, which Curiosity explored.

regions.name: Mawrth Vallis
regions.source: NASA / USGS HiRISE stereo terrain · DTEEC_036305_2025_035804_2025_L01
regions.processing: North-up equirectangular COG window, with calibrated elevation and preserved no-data.

demo.description: Example route through the verified local elevation window.
